question: Which foundry does NVIDIA's fiscal 2026 10-K say manufactures its products?

content.text:
{"reasoning":"Start from NVIDIA's FY2026 10-K Filing. Foundries are Organization nodes linked to NVDA by SUPPLIES (org supplies NVDA) or CUSTOMER_OF (NVDA buys from org). Match organizations whose name or aliases mention foundry names like TSMC, Taiwan Semiconductor, Samsung, or the word foundry. Keep edge chunk_ids from the FY2026 filing plus the organization's EVIDENCED_BY chunks in that filing. Order by number of chunks.","cypher":"MATCH (co:Company {ticker: 'NVDA'})-[:FILED]->(f:Filing {form_type: '10-K', fiscal_period: 'FY2026'})
MATCH (o:Organization)-[r:SUPPLIES]->(co)
WHERE any(x IN [o.name] + coalesce(o.aliases, []) WHERE toLower(x) CONTAINS 'tsmc' OR toLower(x) CONTAINS 'taiwan semiconductor' OR toLower(x) CONTAINS 'samsung' OR toLower(x) CONTAINS 'foundry' OR toLower(x) CONTAINS 'globalfoundries' OR toLower(x) CONTAINS 'intel')
OPTIONAL MATCH (o)-[:EVIDENCED_BY]->(c:Chunk)-[:PART_OF]->(f)
WITH o, [cid IN r.chunk_ids WHERE cid STARTS WITH f.accession_no + ':'] AS edge_ids, collect(c.chunk_id) AS node_ids
WITH o, edge_ids + node_ids AS ids
WHERE size(ids) > 0
RETURN o.name AS foundry, ids AS chunk_ids
ORDER BY size(ids) DESC"}
